items.title_en: This Country Has More Billionaires Per Person Than Anywhere Else
items.title_zh: 这个国家的人均亿万富翁人数比其他任何地方都多
items.summary_en: Monaco, a tiny European microstate, now has the worlds highest billionaire density, driven by tax free personal income, strict financial privacy, and ultra expensive real estate
items.summary_zh: 摩纳哥是一个欧洲小国，在免税个人收入、严格的财务隐私和超昂贵的房地产的推动下，现在拥有世界上最高的亿万富翁密度

items.title_en: Indian Couple Shuts Down Fifth Avenue For Grand Baraat In New York: ‘Money Buys Tickets, Not Class’
items.title_zh: 印度夫妇关闭纽约第五大道 Grand Baraat 门票：“钱买票，不买舱位”
items.summary_en: An Indian couple turned New York’s Fifth Avenue into a lively baraat with music and dance, leaving social media divided over the grand public celebration.
items.summary_zh: 一对印度夫妇将纽约第五大道变成了充满音乐和舞蹈的热闹酒吧，社交媒体对这场盛大的公众庆祝活动产生了分歧。
